steward.people.access-tip: Two readings, deliberately not one: whether an unrevoked period covers right now, and when the latest period ends, revoked ones included. Without the second, somebody whose access was taken away would look exactly like somebody who never had any.
steward.people.active-tip: An unrevoked period covers right now, until
steward.people.appended: If a period is already running, the new one is appended. Paid time is never lost, and periods are never summed across a gap.
steward.people.begins-tip: Bought but not yet begun. A period is appended, never overwritten.
steward.people.counted: . Anybody online while this is written keeps counting up from the new value.
steward.people.day-is-day: A day is exactly 24 hours, not a calendar day.
steward.people.entry-stays: The entry stays and is only marked revoked, which is why a date still stands beside "no access" in the list, instead of the person looking like a stranger.
steward.people.filter-name: Filter people by name, Discord id, or Minecraft account
steward.people.from-launch: If the SMP launch has not been reached, the period starts at that date and not today.
steward.people.grant-note: The bot writes a period with the source ADMIN (no payment, no bunq tab), gives the role and tells the person by direct message.
steward.people.make-admin-note: Below you. Only you and the admins above you can revoke it.

member: In the guild, as the bot last saw it.
left: No longer in the guild. A purchased period keeps running regardless, it is not paused.
banned: Banned in Discord. The login is refused while that holds; the paid period keeps expiring meanwhile.
other: This interface does not know this membership state.

steward.people.most-days: . A longer period is two grants.
steward.people.never-tip: No period has ever been written for this account.
steward.people.no-access-tip: No valid period covers now, although the latest one runs on paper until
. That means either revoked, or bought before the SMP opened, and therefore not yet begun. The periods show which.

true: With this filter and "with access only" nobody is left.
other: No loaded account contains this string in its name or either id.

steward.people.no-pack-tip: Plays without the resource pack from their next login on. Set by
steward.people.no-period-note: None has ever been written for this account, neither bought nor by hand.
steward.people.no-refund: Paid time does not come back this way. A later grant starts fresh and does not credit the revoked remainder.
steward.people.nobody-note: The bot has not seen a single Discord account yet, or it is not running.
steward.people.none-linked: No Minecraft account was linked to
steward.people.none-running: No period was still running for

true: Access paid for, but no Minecraft account linked. This person cannot reach the server until they type the code from the login screen into Discord.

steward.people.over-tip: This period lies entirely behind us.

true: From their next login on, they get the pack like everybody else.
other: From their next login on, the network sends them no pack, until an admin requires it again. Their own local pack then shows.

steward.people.playtime-from: from now on. A journal line names you.
steward.people.playtime-not-written: The play time was not written
steward.people.playtime-note: . The prestige tier follows from it, and there is nothing else to set.

purchase: Bought, but the payment request is no longer in the database; it is set to NULL when the request is deleted.
other: Granted by hand, so there is no payment request.

one: admin below them loses it too. Every open session of theirs ends.
other: admins below them lose it too. Every open session of theirs ends.

steward.people.revoke-note: What is revoked is the whole remaining run of the person this row names: every period not yet expired at once, not a single one.
steward.people.revoked-tip: A revoked period never counts, not even inside its own window.
steward.people.supporter-tip: Given once, never taken away, which is why handing the role out in Discord is harmless.
steward.people.thrown-out: Anyone playing right now is thrown out: the proxy re-checks every connected player's access regularly and disconnects as soon as it no longer holds, not only at the next login.
steward.people.title: Users
steward.people.unknown-id: If the bot does not know this Discord id yet, the account is created for it. A mistyped id therefore produces a person who does not exist, and no error.
steward.people.unknown-person-note: The bot has never seen the Discord account
steward.people.unlink-note: Breaks the link between this Discord account and its Minecraft account. The paid period is untouched; the person can link a Minecraft account again afterwards.

other: has no announcement channel the bot can write to.

steward.said.channels-not-published: discord-bot has not published the guild's channels yet. The ids still work; they just have to be typed.
steward.said.message: Saved, and every service that shows it takes it at once.
steward.said.no-guild-id: discord.guild-id is not set, so there is no guild to list.
steward.said.preview-sent: Sent to you as a direct message.
steward.season.launch-note: What the countdown before launch counts towards.
steward.season.launch-removal: The countdown and the start page go back to having no date. Nothing else moves.
steward.season.reason-note: The reason lands in the journal, together with your name. It may stay empty; then it only records who switched.
steward.season.rebuild: Every season is a full rebuild: every service, every database, every config from scratch. That is why there is deliberately no button here that ends a season. It is not a switch, it is a build.
steward.season.smp-start-removal: Access periods stay where they are, and the next date set moves every live one onto it. This is not an undo.
steward.season.switch-note: The change applies from the next join. Players already on the network are not moved.
steward.season.title: Season

pre-launch: Admins only. Everybody else sees a countdown to the launch date.
pre-event: Every linked, unbanned Discord member. No contribution period is needed.
smp: Linked, unbanned, and the only phase that also requires current access.
maintenance: Everybody reaches the network and stays in limbo; admins are not redirected.

steward.service-page.agent-not-yet: The state of steward-agent is not known yet.
steward.service-page.agent-silent: steward-agent is configured but not answering.
steward.service-page.agent-unknown: The state of steward-agent is unknown: /api/agent did not answer.
steward.service-page.arrives: arrives with the next update run.
steward.service-page.given-tip: The network gives this plugin. It cannot be removed.
steward.service-page.not-yet-installed: It is not installed yet, so only the entry goes. Nothing on the disk is touched.
steward.service-page.recreate-note: A run from the image already on this host. Players are warned and moved first.
steward.service-page.recreate-tip: from the image already on this host.
steward.service-page.remove-jar: A run: the server is stopped for it, with a warning to the players first.
is deleted. Its data folder could not be read out of the jar, so nothing else under plugins/ is touched.
steward.service-page.remove-jar-and-fold: A run: the server is stopped for it, with a warning to the players first.

steward.service-page.send-line: Send a line to the server console
steward.service-page.uncheckable: Updates can't be checked right now.
steward.service.starting: The healthcheck has not reached a verdict yet.
steward.service.unhealthy: The container is running, but its healthcheck is failing.
steward.settings.draft-only: This only changes the draft. Nothing is written to the file until Save.
steward.settings.env-override-tip: An environment variable overrides this until it is removed.
steward.settings.no-colour: No valid colour to preview yet
steward.settings.raw-list: These entries are not uniform enough for one card each. No card fits, so this list stays raw text and is not editable here.

overview: Whether anything needs attention, the numbers behind it, and the season.
updates: What a run would install, the images, the update runs and their schedule.
backups: Runs, archives, retention and the way back.
alerts: What is wrong now, and every alert raised lately.
season: Phase, dates, and what a season change resets.
access: Who may join the server, and why they may.
payments: Incoming bunq payments and the tier that follows from them.
journal: Every change, who triggered it and what it did.

steward.shell.stuck: This is not an expired session. You stay signed in. The interface only knows who you are again once this request gets through.
steward.updates.check-again-tip: Ask the sources again. This takes a moment because it really asks them.
steward.updates.incomplete: A source could not be asked, so this list is incomplete.
steward.updates.no-day: No day is picked, so no update runs.
steward.updates.no-run-note: The schedule and the Update everything button both land here once one has run.
steward.updates.no-section: Steward's config has no update section
steward.updates.no-section-note: The file in the volume predates it. A steward that has started since the section was added writes it in.
steward.updates.nothing-to-install-note: Every source answered and everything the network runs is what the source says is newest.
steward.updates.schedule-note: When an update runs on its own. Empty is never.
